outcome: Emergency and in-hospital health services use within the first year
cohort: 177,901 live births and stillbirths in Ontario, Canada from January 2013 to July 2016
finding: Infants conceived through fertility treatments, both ART and non-ART, had increased risks of adverse perinatal and pediatric health outcomes compared to spontaneously conceived infants.
mod_finding: Infants conceived via assisted reproductive technology (ART) had increased risks of cesarean delivery, preterm birth, very preterm birth, low Apgar scores, and composite neonatal adverse outcomes compared to spontaneously conceived infants.
